title: 第136章 我明白了第135章 涟绥的入轮回
content_zh:
第一卷第136章我明白了
“白蛇，人妖两别，你违逆天道，迷惑凡人，扰乱红尘，罪无可赦！”
“贫道今日便替天行道，收了你这孽障！”
幻境中，身穿黄色道袍的中年道者握紧禅杖，祭出法宝钵盂。
涟绥道人此时修为被限制在金丹境，面对化神境的黄袍道者，就像在面对一座高不可攀的大山。
面对这个与莲尘世尊有九分相似的青年道者，她却并未选择出手，只是冷然看着钵盂不断变大，罩在她头顶。
她很清楚，这里是幻境，是陈椽锡在消磨她的心智。
然而，就在她整个人被钵盂洒下的光辉笼罩时，一道身影却扑在她面前。
“莲尘，你要杀就杀我吧，别伤害我娘子！”
涟绥道人眼中划过一抹意动，但还是选择了冷眼旁观。
她倒要看看，这个故事到底要讲述什么内容！
阵法外，陈玄收回心神。
心中默默对涟绥道人竖起了大拇指。
穿越到白蛇传中，能忍住不和法海这老秃驴过两招，你特娘是这个（大拇指）！
不久前，涟绥道人根据陈玄安排的剧情，或是亲身参与，或是旁观过程，经历了与宋布齐美好的爱情故事。
此时，剧情已接近尾声。
陈椽锡闭着眼睛，将心神寄托在‘莲尘’身上，在完成最后的戏码。
从他嘴角露出的笑意可以看出，这出戏真给他演爽了……
陈玄安排这些，当然不是单纯想看剧，最主要的目的，是将涟绥道人的前世给它安排上。
让她在幻境中一遍又一遍重复同样的剧情，直到道心产生动摇。

同时也能提前在她心中埋下种子，将莲尘放在反派的位置上，让之后莲尘对她态度的剧情效果更好。
这出戏是在凌璇玑拿出太极图之后，陈玄临时安排的，没有太多时间准备剧本，直接将前世看的话本略作改动后搬出来。
也正因准备仓促，整个过程其实并不简单。
原本他是打算先让阵法消磨涟绥道人心智，在她道心处于崩溃边缘的时候，只上演莲尘轻视她跟脚、葫芦仙人给予救赎的两出戏。
现在却是平白多了许多戏码。
陈玄又有些分身乏术，加上幻境无法模拟修为，像莲尘这种修为高深的‘反派’，就只能找别人来演。
而且这些戏码中，有大量需压制涟绥修为的戏份，整个过程可以说相当繁琐。
陈玄只能在心里感谢各位默默付出的幕后人员……
连环大阵中，幻境内苦情剧的片段已经走到最后，涟绥道人的‘前世身’白蛇，被莲尘镇压削掉一身修为，镇压在塔下默默忍受孤独。
凌璇玑借用太极图的威能，在幻境内模拟出时间流逝的假象。
外界不过才几个呼吸，身处幻境的涟绥道人已经感觉过了许多年……
陈椽锡收回心神，只觉心情大为舒坦。
也算是将此前涟绥道人灌给他的一肚子气还回去了。
他看向陈玄，爽朗一笑，说道：“还是你会来事，不仅让这骚蛇吃瘪，还能合情合理的揍她，真解气！”
陈玄淡定一笑。
有了这临时的剧情设定，他将拿下涟绥道人的概率提升到了九成五。
而且自信能让她后续也缓不过气，从头到尾洗涤她浑浊的心灵，彻底把她变成人道的一把利刃。
等此间事了，便是将她放回禅道，陈玄都不会有过多担心。
从太极图读取的记忆来看，她确实为莲台仙宗做了许多事，但与她如今在宗中的地位严重不匹配，待遇甚至还不如许多长老的亲传弟子。
由此得出结论，莲尘本就只将她当做可随时抛弃的工具。

她自己心中也清楚，但能有如今的一切，都是拜莲尘所赐，不过是觉得所受不公待遇，在这天大的恩情面前不值一提罢了。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 136 I understand
"White Snake, there is no difference between a human and a demon. You have violated the laws of heaven, confused mortals, and disturbed the world of mortals. Your sin is unpardonable!"
"I will do justice for heaven today and accept this evil obstacle like you!"
In the illusion, a middle-aged Taoist wearing a yellow Taoist robe clenched his Zen staff and offered up a magic bowl.
At this time, Taoist Liansui's cultivation was limited to the Golden Core Realm. Facing the Taoist in Yellow Robe at the Transformation God Realm was like facing an unreachable mountain.
Facing this young Taoist who was ninety-nine similar to Lord Lianchen, she did not choose to take action. She just watched coldly as the alms bowl continued to grow in size and covered her head.
She knew very well that this was an illusion, and it was Chen Rongxi who was killing her mind.
However, just when her whole body was enveloped by the light from the alms bowl, a figure jumped in front of her.
"Lian Chen, if you want to kill me, just kill me. Don't hurt my wife!"
Taoist Liansui's eyes flashed with emotion, but he still chose to watch indifferently.
She wanted to see what this story was about!
Outside the formation, Chen Xuan recovered his mind.
I silently gave a thumbs up to Taoist Liansui in my heart.
When you travel back in time to the Legend of White Snake, you can resist the temptation to fight with Fa Hai, an old bald ass. This is your special girl (thumbs up)!
Not long ago, Taoist Liansui experienced a beautiful love story with Song Buqi according to the plot arranged by Chen Xuan, either personally participating in it or observing the process.
At this point, the plot is coming to an end.
Chen Rongxi closed his eyes and placed his mind on 'Lian Chen' as he completed the final scene.
It can be seen from the smile on his lips that he really enjoyed the play...
Of course, Chen Xuan arranged this not simply because he wanted to watch a drama. The main purpose was to arrange for it the past life of Taoist Liansui.
Let her repeat the same plot over and over again in the fantasy world until her Taoist heart is shaken.
At the same time, it can also plant the seeds in her heart in advance and put Lian Chen in the villain's position, so that the plot effect of Lian Chen's attitude towards her will be better in the future.
This play was temporarily arranged by Chen Xuan after Ling Xuanji took out the Tai Chi diagram. He didn't have much time to prepare the script, so he just slightly changed the script he read in his previous life and moved it out.
Precisely because of the rush of preparation, the whole process was actually not simple.
Originally, he planned to let the formation consume Taoist Liansui's mind first. When her Taoist heart was on the verge of collapse, he only staged two scenes in which Lian Chen despised her heel and the Gourd Immortal offered salvation.
Now there are a lot more dramas for nothing.
Chen Xuan was a bit lacking in skills, and the fantasy world could not simulate his cultivation. For a 'villain' with advanced cultivation like Lian Chen, he had to find someone else to play the role.
Moreover, among these scenes, there are a large number of scenes that require suppressing Lian Sui's cultivation. The whole process can be said to be quite cumbersome.
Chen Xuan can only thank all the behind-the-scenes staff who have worked silently in his heart...
In the chain of formations, the episode of the bitter drama in the fantasy realm has come to the end. Taoist Liansui's "previous life" White Snake was suppressed by Lian Chen and had his cultivation level cut off, and was suppressed and silently endured loneliness under the tower.
Ling Xuanji borrowed the power of Tai Chi to simulate the passage of time in the fantasy realm.
The outside world has only taken a few breaths, and Taoist Liansui in the illusion has already felt that many years have passed...
Chen Rongxi recovered his mind and felt very comfortable.
It can be regarded as repaying the anger that Taoist Liansui had poured into him before.
He looked at Chen Xuan, smiled heartily, and said: "You are still able to cause trouble. Not only will this coquettish snake be defeated, but you can also beat her up in a reasonable and reasonable way. What a relief!"
Chen Xuan smiled calmly.
With this temporary plot setting, he increased the probability of winning Taoist Liansui to 95%.
Moreover, self-confidence can make her breathless in the future, cleanse her muddy heart from beginning to end, and completely turn her into a sharp blade of humanity.
Once everything is over, Chen Xuan won't have to worry too much even if she is put back into the Zen way.
Judging from the memories read from Tai Chi Tu, she did do many things for the Liantai Immortal Sect, but withHer current status in the sect is seriously mismatched, and her treatment is even worse than that of many elders' direct disciples.
From this, it can be concluded that Lian Chen only regarded her as a tool that could be discarded at any time.
She knew it in her heart, but everything she had now was thanks to Lian Chen. She just felt that the unfair treatment she received was not worth mentioning in front of this huge kindness.
